card.name: Signs and symptoms wording in warnings
card.fires_on: The word symptoms or signs (or the start of symptomatic) in warnings about watching for or reacting to clinical signs. Also the linking comma or 'or' inside 'signs or symptoms' phrases.

modes.label: Symptoms/signs wording
modes.description: The word symptoms, signs, or the start of symptomatic, in instructions about what to do if symptoms occur.
modes.example: Avoid CIBINQO in patients at risk. If<< symptoms>> of thrombosis occur, discontinue

modes.label: Linking word in sign lists
modes.description: A comma or 'or' or 'first' placed just before or after signs and symptoms in a list of reactions.
modes.example: At the first sign<< or>> symptom suggestive of PML, withhold fing

modes.label: The word phenomenon
modes.description: The word phenomenon itself in a dictionary definition.
modes.example: paramagnetism n (Physics) the<< phenomenon>> exhibited by substances that have a relative perme

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word phenomenon or phenomena coming next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a warning talks about signs or symptoms appearing.
